F-143.title: Promote-gate neighbor-lookup returns K=0 for all templates including exact output-shape matches
F-143.claim: The promote-gate's Jaccard similarity step is consistently returning K=0 neighbors for every template tested, including test-gate-overlap (output_shapes=['coverageReport']). Template coverage-tick exists in registry with proposed=False, output_shapes=['coverageReport'], and Jaccard similarity to test-gate-overlap = 1/5 = 0.2 > 0. Despite this, the gate reports K=0. This means the Beta-Binomial projection logic (the primary purpose of the gate) is never reached — every refusal is cold_start_no_similar. The promote-gate as implemented is a cold-start refuser, not a statistical projection gate.
